detail: DISCOVERY (2026-08-05): the reconciled M0-T019 target (next==15.5.21, react==19.1.2, react-dom==19.1.2, eslint-config-next==15.5.21, override postcss==8.5.23) regenerates a package-lock whose FULL transitive tree carries advisories the resolver-time .npmrc filter cannot retroactively remove from already-selected transitives. Multiple advisories; the combined advisory-free thresholds are >=1.1.18 (1.x line), >=2.1.4 (2.x line), >=5.0.9 (5.x line) - the entire 3.x/4.x lines remain vulnerable to GHSA (exponential-time expansion, vulnerable >=3.0.0 <5.0.7). Remediable WITHOUT Next 16 via a package.json override `sharp: 0.35.3` (published 2026-07-01T11:28:34.077Z; advisory-free; ~35 days old - NOT age-blocked). (3) next 'depends on vulnerable sharp' - this finding resolves automatically once sharp is overridden. NET: sharp is fixable tonight via override; brace-expansion is the hard blocker because every advisory-free version is <7 days old. FE-S9 (the committed-lockfile release-age gate) has NO allowlist/suppression/--ignore/exception path by design, and the owner previously DECLINED age exceptions for M0-T019 (B-013). Therefore an advisory-free AND >=7-day-old tree is not achievable before 2026-08-06T10:00-10:17Z.
